Punjab AAP MLA Suspended After Raising Teacher Shortage Concerns

Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) MLA Sukhveer Maiserkhana from Punjab has been suspended by his party after publicly raising concerns about a teacher shortage and alleging that the government had ignored his previous pleas. The suspension followed his public questioning of the party's 'education revolution'.
